content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to know if it is possible to transmit the counted value (refer to the counter in the attachment) to a PC (in this case, a Raspberry Pi running a Python program). If this is achievable, how should the output be defined? Any advice would be appreciated. Best regards [user_name]
The value from an up/down counter is a 32-bit unsigned Integer (DInt). You can use the VM Mapping feature to transfer the value into VM memory for access.

Hello, I don't personally use Raspberry Pi, but I believe you will find it straightforward. I recommend starting by reading the discussion on this topic—it should be helpful. Secondly, assign your counter value to a mathematical instruction and then link it to a network analog output as shown here.
Keep in mind, this approach works only if your counter value stays below 32,768.
Thank you for your responses. Both suggestions are suitable, since the counter will reset every hour and won't exceed 10,000.
